title: Quantity-normal ventilation.
officialText:
During occupied conditions, the mechanical ventilation system shall exhaust the larger
of the following:
1. Not less than 0.5 cfm per square foot (0.0025m3/s m2) of machinery room area or 20 cfm (0.009m3/s) per
person; or
2. A volume required to limit the room temperature rise to18°F (10°C) taking into account the ambient heating
effect of all machinery in the room but not above a maximum temperature of 122°F (50°C).
